name: Bramblewick
description: Birds sat on it and things grew. Bramblewick carries a hedge it never planted and walks the boundary that hedge has since become, at a pace that brings it back to the same gate about once a year. Nobody has ever moved it out of the way. There is a wren in there.
babyDescription: A bare shell that the birds have already started sitting on.
teenDescription: The seeds have taken. It has given up turning round quickly, in case something falls off.
adultDescription: A slow hedge with legs, going the long way round a field it has always gone round.
